programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 大學時期的男主角月岡夏，與同學南雲水季交往起來，並過著幸福的日子。然而，正當他們都在忙著就業活動的時候，水季卻突然向他提出分手，從此兩人分道揚鑣。就這樣過了七年，已經開展新生活的夏，卻突然收到大學時代朋友的通知，原來水季已經離開了人世。從分手那天起就沒有再見過水季的夏，帶著難以置信的心情去參加了水季的葬禮。在葬禮上，夏見到了一個名叫海的小女孩，並得知她是水季和他的女兒，讓他感到十分震驚。原來當年水季竟瞞著他生下了他們的孩子，並且一直默默地撫養著這個孩子。知道這一切以後，夏開始思考水季和海在這七年間的生活。

programme.title: E5
programme.desc: 三位51歲、對人生感到失意的中年大叔——吉井雄太、藤卷肇與菊原紀介，因故鄉傳來「工地挖出人骨」的新聞而重聚。他們原是少年時代的電影研究部夥伴，卻在回憶往昔時，驚覺他們的女顧問老師竟被標註為「行方不明」。這個發現，點燃了他們追查老師神祕失蹤真相的決心，也開啟了一段重新檢視自我與青春的救贖之旅。

programme.title: E11
programme.desc: 「常勝律師」唐盈盈（辛芷蕾飾）與頂頭上司康俊（林雨申飾）在一樁樁眾生百態的案件中過招，在碰撞中釐清中國式「人情與法理」難題，並最終收穫自身成長的動人故事。

programme.title: E6
programme.desc: 醫學院輟學生李宇謙涉嫌綁架殺害223人，卻宣稱掌握「治癒所有疾病」的技術。如今這項只存在他腦中的奇蹟，成為要挾世界的籌碼：「赦免我，否則帶著秘密進墳墓」。同時絕望律師為救患有腦瘤的女兒，必須保護兇手。而正義檢察官卻為223條冤魂，誓死送他上刑場。二人的博弈一觸即發。李宇謙究竟是冷血殺手，還是人類的救星？

programme.desc: 醫學院輟學生李宇謙涉嫌綁架殺害223人，卻宣稱掌握「治癒所有疾病」的技術。如今這項只存在他腦中的奇蹟，成為要挾世界的籌碼：「赦免我，否則帶著秘密進墳墓」。同時絕望律師為救患有腦瘤的女兒，必須保護兇手。而正義檢察官卻為223條冤魂，誓死送他上刑場。二人的博弈一觸即發。李宇謙究竟是冷血殺手，還是人類的救星？

programme.desc: 節目煥新升級，打破原有賽制，以「聽世界的聲音，唱我們的歌」為主題，廣邀了劉宇寧、毛不易、馬嘉祺、古巨基、李克勤、騰格爾、龔琳娜等三十多位歌手平行演繹，回歸音樂本質，共同打造融合金曲，為歌手之間的合作與交流提供更多的可能性，打造充滿無限活力的音樂盛宴。

programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 名門千金東方曦為愛隱姓埋名打工供養男友，慘遭背叛後覺醒，竟發現自己身處小說世界，成了注定悲劇的惡毒女配；為了改寫命運，她與系統達成賭約，不僅當眾揭穿了渣男的真面目，更發現暗中守護自己的大哥竟是系統化身。這是一場關於覺醒、反殺與破局的奇幻愛戀，挑戰傳統的黑月光法則。

programme.title: E1 - Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

programme.title: E2 - Double Trouble
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

programme.title: E1 - Start of Trauma Season
programme.desc: Scramble as the ER team tends to a spring flood of patients. Watch vet Phil stabilize an ailing joey as the rescue team fends off a rude kangaroo. Shadow senior vet Tim, who treats a cat-scratched bandicoot and snakes a keelback out of a grate.

programme.title: E2 - Operation Pelican
programme.desc: Head out with rescuer Jo to scoop up a pelican who’s swallowed a fish hook, then see Sam free a newborn bat tangled in a fence. Follow vet Tim, who aids a surly koala with an eye infection, and watch a lumpy python give newbie Ruby a load of trouble.

programme.title: E3 - Gutsy Koala
programme.desc: Shadow vet Bec, who patches up dog-bitten koala Rachel, and new vets Ruby and Kerryn, who soothe a pack of itchy possums. Free a pair of kookaburras trapped in a wall with rescue officer Dani and watch vet Tim’s squirrel glider knee surgery.

programme.title: E3 - Rocco, Harold and Cindy
programme.desc: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

programme.title: E4 - Milton, Cash and Bentley
programme.desc: Celebrate Cash the house donkey’s birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

programme.title: E6 - Buffalo Showdown
programme.desc: To the lion, the buffalo is not only a satisfying dinner but also dangerous. Track a herd of 300 buffalo along with the Mwamba pride, who must act quickly and carefully if they are to take down their prey.

programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

programme.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. It’s a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

programme.title: E3 - Jill's Art-rageous Makeover
programme.desc: It's makeover time for Artsy August! Give Mom a wild new look with crazy makeup and pink hair. Then, fix your friends' broken items with crafts on the bus, hunt for treasure as a mermaid, and play detective to find a missing bunny!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures S1E1 -High-Flying Fun!
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, & learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok & the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, & discovery.

programme.title: E4 - Fun Facts About The World!
programme.desc: Blippi is learning fun facts all about the world! He & D.BO shrink down to meet Ernie the Eraser, an aspiring magician who teaches them the science behind how erasers work. Then, they fly into the night sky to learn how fireworks get their colors & why some animals, like raccoons, prefer to come out at night. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how to be a cowboy in the desert & helps a brave spoon protect his cereal from getting soggy!

programme.title: E6 - Mila & Chroma's August Splat-tacular
programme.desc: Get set for an Artsy August adventure! Race with Mila and Morphle in a hot air balloon against tricky racers. Then, help them find a cure for a sneezing Chroma who is covering the city in paint, and join a wild, musical talent show chase!

programme.title: E22 - JJ's Artsy August Class
programme.desc: Get creative for Artsy August! Join Ms. Appleberry's class to learn how red, blue, and yellow Jello can mix to make purple, orange, and green. Then, transform toy cars with a splash of paint and learn how to tap dance to the beat!

programme.title: E6 - Magic, A Blob, A Show & A Bubble!
programme.desc: Join Bubbles for a day of magic, a blob, a show & a bubble! First, Bubbles is excited to watch Pogo's magic show, but her curiosity gets the better of her & she spoils his tricks! Then, she invents a brand new bouncy blob, but it bounces out of control & causes havoc all over the Bodpod! The adventures continue as Bubbles gets stage fright before a big show & tries her best to stop a giant, beautiful bubble from popping.

programme.title: E2 - A Big Day of Games & Fun!
programme.desc: Get ready for a big day of discovery & play with Twinkle & her friends! The fun starts as they learn to play new musical instruments, with Twinkle on drums, Kitty on the sax & Bunny on guitar! Then, it's time to play a fun game of 'Twinkle Says'! Follow along as they give you playful instructions & see if you can keep up. The discoveries continue as the friends find a mirror & make funny faces & wonder what an umbrella is for before it starts to rain!

programme.title: E1 - When Baby Daniel Causes Total Mayhem!
programme.desc: Get ready for some total mayhem caused by Baby Daniel! The chaos begins when Daniel finds the remote to control Arpo, turning the robot babysitter into everything from an elephant to a bird! Then, Arpo is tasked with cleaning the kitchen, but Daniel just wants to play, making an even bigger mess. From getting covered in mud to being extra noisy while Daddy is trying to sleep, Baby Daniel keeps Arpo on his toes in this fun-filled, chaotic adventure!

programme.title: The Fatal Raid
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, Inspector Tam Ka Ming, Hei and Special Female Force team Madam, Shirley and a group of commandos started a secret operation to chase a group of gangster across the border of Hong Kong. This led to a large and drawn-out firefight between the police and gangsters, resulting in Shirley and a number of commandos killed in operation. The incident caused Inspector Tam and Madam Fong having a nightmare in these twenty years. Twenty years later, an escort operation bringing Inspector Tam and Madam Fong with four new-generation Special Female Force teammate Alma, Zi Han, Sheila, and Tong Yu to Macau, a group of gangster stormed the operation and they find Hei is still alive...

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: This is a story between the mole in the police department, Ming(Andy Lau) and the undercover cop, Yan(Tony Leung), who are competing to uncover each other first...

programme.title: Summer Wars
programme.desc: Worlds collide in a tale where virtual reality meets actual reality. When Kenji Koiso is pulled from Oz, a popular social networking realm, to play fiance to classmate Natsuki, he faces a mess of challenges. Between the boisterous and bickering characters of the Jinnouchi clan and the sudden chaos in Oz, Kenji and his new companions must learn the importance of coming together to face the toughest of odds.

programme.title: E1 - The Force of Nature
programme.desc: Climate change is our defining crisis, and it is happening even faster than we thought. But we're not powerless to stop it. The impacts of climate change are felt in every corner of the world. Increased temperatures are causing environmental disasters. The sea levels are rising, the Arctic is melting, coral reefs are dying, oceans are acidifying, and forests are burning. It is clear that business as usual is not an option. With climate change reaching irreversible heights, now is the time for bold collective action. The climate emergency is a race we are losing, but it is a race we can win.

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: The iconic Giant Panda is on the brink. With only 1600 left in the wild, pressures on their natural habitat and a notoriously small window for reproduction are edging them towards extinction - fast. Over 1 year, we go behind-the-scenes and follow the incredible work of a dedicated group of zookeepers and vets as they race to get Singapore’s famed couple… to fall in ‘love’. The team from the River Safari has a tough road ahead. This film follows the year that Kai Kai and Jia Jia become the focus of attention not just from the general public but from the scientists themselves in the greatest challenge Singapore Zoo has faced yet.

programme.title: E15
programme.desc: 法醫齊思哲在調查女友死因的過程中，捲入一樁樁懸案，與刑警祝青越、韓烽攜手屢破詭案，並牽扯出背後「原鑽」毒品疑案的故事。

programme.title: E14
programme.desc: 《虎鶴妖師錄》講述了樂觀開朗的山野孤兒虎子因誤打誤撞吞食了至陽寶物赤珠，而結識了冷峻潔癖的國御妖師隊長祁曉軒。兩個性格迥異的年輕人因一顆赤珠被迫一起上路，結識了趙馨彤、王羽千、 山茶等夥伴，就在人妖兩界的野心要為人間帶來一場浩劫之時，一眾有夢想的熱血少年不惜自我犧牲，拯救人間的故事。

programme.title: E13
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: 講述了大學畢業三年後，羅豔（李庚希飾）經媽媽介紹進入一家離家不遠的傳統型公司做閒差，別人羨慕她輕鬆悠閒，她卻厭倦了枯燥的生活；出入高檔寫字樓的姜小果（卜冠今飾）實際上每天加班沒有自己的生活；突如其來的家庭經濟危機讓段家寶（董思怡飾）從「富二代」變成了「負二代」；梁爽（關曉彤飾）成了全網頂尖的美妝護膚主播，但她的事業起起伏伏。儘管生活的路總是令人困惑而踟躕，但女孩們從不停止向前的腳步。這是充滿艱難，也充滿光明的25歲。
